propositions: docs/releasing.md incorrectly describes the pypi environment required-reviewers rule as a second human approval and an interactive prompt, when in fact it is a non-interactive self-approvable gate by the configured release identity

the pypi environment has one required reviewer (JoeOakhartNava, the release identity), with prevent_self_review disabled and admin bypass enabled, so the approval is neither independent review nor a human-facing checkpoint
the release source review guarantee comes from Gerrit-reviewed main, not from the environment rule; the environment rule only controls identity-scoped access to the publish job and its OIDC token

the runbook must document the non-interactive REST approval path using pending_deployments with explicit JSON body (environment_ids as array, state, comment) instead of field flags, and show the companion GET read that discovers the environment id
the workflow comment at release.yml:294 repeats the incorrect framing and must be corrected to match the fixed documentation
